variants.bio:
Hog is a cheerful, innocent, and heroic mascot who lives on the fictional planet Torus. In his own native universe, he is a small, bipedal blue tenrec rather than a hedgehog. Alongside his loyal companions Prowler the Fennec and Fists the Porcupine, Hog spends his time constantly fighting off the evil schemes of a villain named Dr. Drauss Mechanix (also known as CabbageMan).

Visually, Hog looks like a compact, chibi-style counterpart to Sonic. He stands at a short 3'1", sporting a bright blue body, peach-colored patches around his mouth and belly, thick-outlined conjoined eyes, and side tufts on his quills. He completely lacks a visible mouth most of the time and wears simple white gloves, socks, and solid black shoes with a signature white stripe.

In the overarching meta-lore, Hog's entire reality was accidentally generated when a real-world developer tampered with an official Sonic the Hedgehog Mega Drive cartridge. The original file glitched so severely that the machine overwrote the classic coding, inadvertently deleting the original world of Mobius and forcing a completely bootlegged game—starring Hog—to overwrite the disk space.

On the contrary, Scorched is the dark, corrupted, and deeply vengeful entity that hides directly inside Hog’s shadow. He is actually the original Sonic the Hedgehog, who tragically survived the annihilation of his home universe. Stranded alone in the Void while screaming atoms tore his world apart, Sonic woke up trapped as a dormant consciousness buried deep within the backend code of Hog's replacement game. Driven completely insane by grief and intense jealousy over Hog living the heroic life that was stolen from him, Sonic transformed into a bitter, power-hungry monster.

When Scorched violently tears through the fabric of the game to hijack Hog's body, his physical form undergoes a grotesque transformation. He stands at a terrifying, lanky 13'0" tall, boasting a heavily distorted, vein-pulsing grayish-blue anatomy with massive claws and elongated, rubber-hose limbs. His mouth stretches wide into a jagged, sharp-toothed maw, his eyes become hollow black voids leaking corrupted code, and his shoes appear shattered, cracked, and fused together.

Scorched's powers revolve around glitched code manipulation, reality distortion, and thermal incineration. During his reign of terror in the game, he begins systematically trapping and murdering Hog's best friends, Prowler and Fists, actively devouring their digital code as "food" to harvest their energy. His ultimate tragic goal is to gather the powerful Soul Rubies to recreate his old dead universe, a pursuit that eventually ends in a cataclysmic overload that destroys both entities and ruins the cartridge permanently.
